rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's twelve builder trees go (magnolias, jacarandas and a eucalyptus along the back fences, a magnolia 2.9 m from a house); five come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by the grill and the chair, two swing sets, on the open lot corner and the north back lot line.

trees.why: the back yard with the kettle grill and the white adirondack: a magnolia over both
the south yard with the swing set (2.8 m off): shade over the swings
the west yard's swing set (2.8 m off): the same, 29 m on
the open lot corner at the north-east, 24 m from the walls: an old ficus
the north back lot line, 10 m from the houses: a jacaranda between two yards
